title: Concept: Index URL declared over cleartext
description: requirements.txt declares a requirements file that points at a cleartext index, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a requirements file that points at a cleartext index.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads a requirements file that points at a cleartext index.
